g.text: Arrows compare with your average for the 4 weeks before.
Start fresh when you switch topics
On Wednesday, "refactor the auth middleware in src/auth/middleware.ts" moved on to
something new while it already held about 330k tokens of the earlier topic. Over the next 3
prompts, re-reading that context cost about $1.16.
Try this: Type /clear or start a new session when you move to something unrelated.
This week so far: 2 of 3 switches.
